payload.prompt: Create one original photorealistic ecommerce product photograph. Product description: A oversized hoodie made from organic-cotton blend, finished with tonal hardware. No collage, montage, split panels, extra views, detail cutouts, detached garment parts, repeated items, or multiple angles. Trousers have exactly two attached legs in a single complete garment.
